G5601.def:
Ἰωβήδ (WH, -βήλ, Lk, l.with; Rec., RV, Ὠβήδ), ὁ, indecl., 
Jo bed (Obed): Matthieu 1:5, Luc 3:32.†

G5602.def:
ὧδε, adv., 
[in LXX for חֲלֹם ,פֹּה ,הִנֶּה, etc. ;] 
__1. prop., of manner, so (Hom., al.). 
__2. In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place, 
__(a) hither (BL, §25, 2): Matthieu 8:29, Marc 11:3, Luc 9:41, Jean 6:25, al.; ἕως ὧδε, Luc 23:5; 
__(b) here: Matthieu 12:6, Marc 9:1, Luc 9:33, Jean 6:9, al.; τὰ ὧδε, Colossiens 4:9; opposite to ἐκεῖ, Hébreux 7:8; ὧδε . . . ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), Matthieu 24:23, Marc 13:21; metaphorically, here (i.e. in this circumstance or connection), 1 Corinthiens 4:2, Apocalypse 13:10, 18 14:12 17:9.

G5603.def:
ᾠδή, -ῆς, ή 
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;] 
a song, ode, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ: Apocalypse 5:9 14:3 15:3; ᾠ πνευματικαί Éphésiens 5:19, Colossiens 3:16.†

G5604.def:
ὠδίν
(late form of ὠδίς), -ῖνος, ἡ [in LXX for חֵבֶל חֶבֶל (and wrongly for חֶבֶל חֶבֶל, cf. Ac, l.with), חִיל, etc. ;] 
a birth pang, travail pain: 1 Thessaloniciens 5:3; metaphorically, of extreme suffering, Matthieu 24:8, Marc 13:8; ὠδῖνες θανάτου (Psaumes 18:4 מָוֶת חֶבֶל), Actes 2:24.†

G5605.def:
ὠδίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for חוּל, also for חָבַל pi., etc. ;] 
to have birthpangs, to travail: Galates 4:27 (LXX), Apocalypse 12:2; metaphorically, Galates 4:19 (cf. συν-ωδίνω).†

G5606.def:
ὦμος, οὐ, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly for שְׁכֶם, כָּתֵף ;] 
the shoulder: Matthieu 23:4, Luc 15:5.†

G5608.def:
ὠνέομαι, -οῦραι 
to buy: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; see Rutherford, NPhr., 210 ff.; Veitch, see word), with genitive pret., Actes 7:16.†

G5609.def:
ᾠόν
(Rec. ὠόν), -οῦ, τό [in LXX for בֵּיצָה ;] 
an egg: Luc 11:12.†

G5610.def:
ὥρα, -ας, ἡ, 
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה ;] 
__1. any time or period fixed by nature, esp. a season (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.). 
__2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, an hour: Matthieu 24:36, Marc 13:32, Actes 10:3, al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), Jean 4:52, Actes 10:3, 30 1 Corinthiens 15:30, Apocalypse 3:3; accusative of duration, Matthieu 20:12 26, Marc 14:37; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, for a season, for a time, Jean 5:35, 2 Corinthiens 7:8, Galates 2:5; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, for a short season (ICC, in l.), 1 Thessaloniciens 2:17. 
__3. A definite point of time, time, hour: Matthieu 26:45; with genitive of thing(s), Luc 1:10 14:17, Apocalypse 3:10, al.; with genitive of person(s), Luc 22:53, Jean 2:4 7:30, al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, 1 Corinthiens 4:11; ἐσχάτη ὥ., 1 Jean 2:18; before ὅτε, Jean 4:21, 23 5:25 16:25; ἵνα, Jean 12:23, al.; with accusative and inf., Romains 13:11 (cf. DB, ext., 475b 476b).

G5611.def:
ὡραῖος, -α, -ον 
(ὥρα), [in LXX for נָאָה, טוֹב, יָפָה, etc. ;] 
seasonable, timely, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, blooming, beautiful (both of things and persons): Matthieu 23:27, Actes 3:2, 10, Romains 10:15 (LXX, ὥρα).†

G5612.def:
ὠρύομαι depon., 
[in LXX for שָׁאַג ;] 
of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), to roar, howl: λέων, 1 Pierre 5:8.†

G5614.def:
ὡσαννά (T, ὠσ-) (Heb נָא and הוֹשֵׁעַ; see Dalman, Words, 220 IL; Gr., 249), 
hosanna: Matthieu 21:9, Marc 11:9-10, Jean 12:13; τ. υἱῷ Δανείδ, Matthieu 21:9, 15.†

G5615.def:
ὡσαύτως 
adv., 
strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ᾽ αὔτως, later in one word), in like manner, just so, likewise: Matthieu 20:5 21:30, 36 25:17, Marc 14:31, Luc 13:5 20:31, Romains 8:26, 1 Timothée 5:25, Tite 2:6; with verb to be supplied from context, Marc 12:21, Luc 22:20, 1 Corinthiens 11:25, 1 Timothée 2:9 3:8 3:11, Tite 2:3.†

G5616.def:
ὡσεί 
adv., 
__(a) as if, .as it were, like as, like: Matthieu 3:16 9:36, Actes 2:3 6:15, Romains 6:13, Hébreux 1:12; γίνεσθαι (φαίνεσθαι) ὡσεί, Marc 9:26, Luc 22:44 ([WH] R, mg., om.), Luc 24:11; 
__(b) in calculation, and with numbers, about: Matthieu 14:21, Luc 3:23 9:14, 28 22:41, 59 23:44, Actes 2:41 10:3 19:7; ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, Luc 22:41.†

G5617.def:
Ὠσηέ (Tr., Ὁσ-), ὁ (Heb. הוֹשֵׁעַ), 
Hosea: Romains 9:25.†

G5618.def:
ὥσ-περ 
adv., 
just as, even as: Matthieu 6:2 20:28, Actes 3:17, 1 Corinthiens 8:5, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:3 al.; in protasis, with οὕτως (καί) in apodosis: Matthieu 12:40, Luc 17:24, Jean 5:21, Romains 5:19, Galates 4:29, Jacques 2:26, al

G5619.def:
ὡσ-περ-εί 
adv., 
as, as it were: 1 Corinthiens 15:8.†

G5620.def:
ὥσ-τε 
consecutive particle, 
__1. with infin., expressing result, so as to: Matthieu 8:24 12:22, Marc 1:27, Luc 5:7, Actes 1:19, Romains 7:6, 1 Corinthiens 1:7, Hébreux 13:6, al.; of a designed result, Matthieu 10:1, Luc 4:29, al.; preceded by οὕτως, Actes 14:1; by τοσοῦτος, Matthieu 15:33. 
__2. C. indic., 
__(a) so that: Galates 2:13, preceded by οὕτως, Jean 3:16; 
__(b) so then, therefore: Matthieu 12:12, Marc 2:28, Romains 7:4, 1 Corinthiens 3:7, Galates 3:9, al. 
__3. so then, therefore: with subjc., 1 Corinthiens 5:8; with imperat., 1 Corinthiens 3:21 4:5, Philippiens 2:12 1 Thessaloniciens 4:18, 1 Pierre 4:19, al

G5621.def:
ὠτίον, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς, 
[in LXX for אֹזֶן ;] 
an ear: Matthieu 26:51, Luc 22:51, Jean 18:26.†

G5622.def:
ὠφέλεια (WH, -λία), -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;] 
__1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.). 
__2. profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): Romains 3:1, Ju 16.†

G5623.def:
ὠφελέω, -ῶ
(ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;] 
to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., Romains 2:25; οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, Notes, 21), Matthieu 27:24, Jean 6:63 12:19; with accusative of person(s), Hébreux 4:2; with dupl. accusative, Marc 8:36, 1 Corinthiens 14:6, Galates 5:2; pass., Hébreux 13:9; with accusative, Matthieu 15:5 16:26, Marc 5:26 7:11, Luc 9:25, 1 Corinthiens 13:3.†

G5624.def:
ὠφέλιμος, -ον
(ὠφελέω), 
useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., Tite 3:8; before πρός, with accusative, 1 Timothée 4:8, 2 Timothée 3:16.†
